messages.text: The Traveler 12-inch Blue Ocean Desk Globe is sized for exactly that — a desk, bookshelf, or credenza, with a bright, easy-to-read political map and raised relief detail. It's a great everyday desktop pick. Is this one for your own desk, or is it a gift for someone?

Nice — a globe makes a really thoughtful gift, something that lasts and gets used, not tucked in a drawer. Do you know if the person you're giving it to already has a desk globe, or would this be their first?

A first globe is a fun one to get right — the Traveler's bright blue ocean and raised relief mountains make it easy and satisfying to explore right away, no learning curve. You'll find it under that exact name, Traveler 12-inch Blue Ocean Desk Globe - Raised Relief Political Map, ready to add to your cart.
